kapak.alt: The vector in OTOF gene therapy

youtube.baslik: Why is the otoferlin gene delivered to the ear in two pieces? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In OTOF-related hearing loss, gene therapy carries a working copy of the gene for otoferlin, a protein needed at the inner hair cell synapse, into the cochlea. The vector most used in the inner ear is the adeno-associated virus (AAV), but the amount of genetic material it can carry is limited, and the coding sequence of the otoferlin gene is larger than this limit; so the gene is split into two parts given with two separate AAVs, and inside the cell the parts join to form the full protein. These trials are small and at an early stage.
